property_summary: For any non-zero newOwner, transferOwnership(newOwner) must make owner() equal newOwner; the mutant sets owner to address(0) instead, so owner() != newOwner for any non-zero fuzzed address.
change_summary: Replace _transferOwnership(newOwner) with _transferOwnership(address(0)) so the owner is always set to the zero address regardless of the argument.
